def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)

    markers=set(); block=set()

            block.add((i,j))
        else:
            markers.add((i,j))
    bi=[i for i,_ in block]; bj=[j for _,j in block]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(bi),max(bi),min(bj),max(bj)
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    if bh%2==0: # expand
        if r1==h-1: r0-=1

    if bw%2==0:
